execution: Categorical inverse-CDF selection of exactly one proposal;never average action coordinates.
actor_objective: Only native full-horizon variational EIG. Exact critic expectation -mean(sum_k p_k Q(h,a_k)) for mixture actor;unchanged native deterministic critic gradient for standalone pretraining. Native categorical Monte Carlo target backups. No other loss/reward.
router: 146 observed-history/proposal/belief/horizon inputs ->64SiLU->4softmax;zero output initialization. Uniform bypasses router and uses exact.25 in train/targets/eval.
parent: Existing trained uniform101 for semantic/provider initialization;shared collaboration head/base deliberately discarded. Known inherited training costs are separate.

success: Complete budgets,all4 standalone interfaces valid,paired learned-minus-uniform95% CI lower>0,and learned-minus-collaborative95% CI lower>-.1nat. One-seed evidence permits considering expansion,never automatic five-seed launch.
fairness: Same expert pretrained weights,router weights,critic,posterior and RNG within pair;independent mixture training with same native work. All4 common expert pretraining wall/simulation costs charged to each method,not hidden. Shared pretraining/evaluation and reference scoring charged before routing cap.
